strings.tagGDX1CompA101Desc: "The seal, emblazoned by Ulgard the Mighty, focused the creator's considerable arcane power into unmatched physical might."(Used in all weapons, shields and caster off-hands)
strings.tagGDX1CompA102Desc: "The seal, devised by the legendary nightblade Belgothian, amplified the assassin's already deadly attacks and stimulated bleeding in the target."(Used in all weapons, shields and caster off-hands)
strings.tagGDX1CompA103Desc: "The seal, first emblazoned by the arcane master Trozan, calls forth power from the celestial skies themselves."(Used in all weapons, shields and caster off-hands)
strings.tagGDX1CompA104Desc: "The seal, infused with the power of the Three, evokes every disease the victim ever suffered in the past."(Used in all weapons, shields and caster off-hands)
strings.tagGDX1CompA105Desc: "Though the creator of this seal lies forgotten to history, its ability to tap into the Aether cannot be overstated."(Used in all weapons, shields and caster off-hands)
strings.tagGDX1CompA106Desc: "The creation of this seal required unspeakable acts to be committed. Those found using it are looked upon as power hungry and corrupt."(Used in all weapons, shields and caster off-hands)
strings.tagGDX1CompA107Desc: "Devised by the nightblade Amarasta in preparation for a particularly elusive target."(Used in all weapons, shields and caster off-hands)
strings.tagGDX1CompA108Desc: "A seal created in the honor of Ulzuin and the blazing ends promised upon those who scorn the celestial being."(Used in all weapons, shields and caster off-hands)

strings.tagGDX1CompA115Desc: "The earth was infused with life essence to stimulate growth and health."(Used in all armor)
strings.tagGDX1CompA116Desc: "Remnants of armor that survived a deadly arcane attack; the magical energies appear to be trapped within the metal."(Used in all armor)
strings.tagGDX1CompA117Desc: "Armor plated fitted with rows of deadly blades. A favorite amongst brigands and ruthless tyrants."(Used in all armor)
strings.tagGDX1CompA118Desc: "Leather from the beasts inhabiting the region known as Ugdenbog. The bog's deadly properties create some of the toughests beasts ever to roam Cairn."(Used in all armor)

strings.tagGDX1EnchantC107Desc: "A gift from the Ravager to stifle blood loss and make the user more difficult to track."(Applied to all armor)
strings.tagGDX1EnchantC108Desc: "A gift from the Ravager to ward the soul against wraiths."(Applied to all armor)
strings.tagGDX1EnchantC109Desc: "A gift from the Ravager to strengthen the mortal coil."(Applied to all armor)
strings.tagGDX1FeetC102_Desc: "It is uncertain whether the bones attached to these boots belong to beast...or man."
strings.tagGDX1FeetD103_Desc: "Legend goes that these boots can transcend the infinite timelines, but nobody has yet figured out how to harness this power."
strings.tagGDX1FeetD110_Desc: "The boots bore the full brunt of a lightning storm, and yet do not discharge completely into the earth beneath them."
strings.tagGDX1FocusB101Desc: "Filled with knowledge of the Aether, much of which cannot be deciphered."
strings.tagGDX1FocusB102Desc: "Filled with arcane knowledge known only to Terrnox."
strings.tagGDX1FocusC102_Desc: "The rotting head emits a foul stench, but the toxins it produces are even more vile."
strings.tagGDX1FocusC103_Desc: "Malligosta was a master of the art of channeling spiritual energies into devastating spells. She was equal parts necromancer and arcanist."
strings.tagGDX1FocusC104_Desc: "Inquisitor Abalon was one of the most daring inquisitors of his time, willing to make use of any relic so long as it ultimately served the security of the empire. Some would later call his methods heresy."
strings.tagGDX1FocusC114_Desc: "The real trick is to hold the sphere without injuring oneself."
strings.tagGDX1FocusD101_Desc: "The scythe subtly vibrates when lingering spirits are near."
strings.tagGDX1FocusD105_Desc: "The arcane flame is fickle and difficult to control. A single lapse in concentration and the flame could pass on to a new master."
strings.tagGDX1FocusD111_Desc: "Farath's puzzle cube has only been solved once before, but the bearer was said to have gone blind upon witnessing the arcane splendors contained within."
strings.tagGDX1HandsC101_Desc: "Haruud's grasp was said to carry the chill of death itself with it."
strings.tagGDX1HandsC104_Desc: "With a mere touch, evil recedes in fear."
strings.tagGDX1HandsD101_Desc: "Having reached into the void itself, these gloves are forever changed by the encounter."
strings.tagGDX1HandsD109_Desc: "Dripping with gore and thirsting for more, the claws eagerly seek out fresh victims."
strings.tagGDX1HeadB103_Desc: "You have no idea how many victims this mask consists of."
strings.tagGDX1HeadB104_Desc: "The stench coming off this mask is unbearable."
strings.tagGDX1HeadB107_Desc: "The chill of death is heavy upon this cowl."
strings.tagGDX1HeadC101_Desc: "The spirits trapped within the circlet sometimes whisper secrets to the bearer, though perhaps not always with the bearer's best interests in mind."
strings.tagGDX1HeadC103_Desc: "The world is filled with heathens and heretics and so, by the grace of the Luminari, it shall be purged of this damnation."
strings.tagGDX1HeadC105_Desc: "The horns are still teeming with a palpable darkness."
strings.tagGDX1HeadC108_Desc: "Though vanquished from the physical realm, some part of the Ravager spirit remains within the twisted mask."
strings.tagGDX1HeadD109_Desc: "A blessing, and a curse, bestowed upon the bearer of Dreeg's word, the one voice through which the Witch God echoes his cryptic messages."
strings.tagGDX1HeadD110_Desc: "The divine light of Empyrion shines down upon the bearer of this crown."
strings.tagGDX1HeadD111_Desc: "Though vanquished from the physical realm, some part of the Ravager spirit remains within the twisted mask."
strings.tagGDX1HeroWendigoCannibal_H03: Palros, Protector of the Pack ~ Defender
strings.tagGDX1LegsC103_Desc: "Somehow the shadows themselves have been woven into the fabric of this armor."
strings.tagGDX1LegsD101_Desc: "The fur stinks of old blood, uncertain whether it is from the wendigo itself or from its past victims."
strings.tagGDX1LegsD110_Desc: "The beast which gave up its fur for the creation of this armor does not appear to be local to Erulan."
strings.tagGDX1MedalB101_Desc: "The fangs still drip with petrifying venom."
strings.tagGDX1MedalB102_Desc: "The fangs still drip with hemorrhaging venom."
strings.tagGDX1MedalB104_Desc: "The Chthonian scale is teeming with the darkness of the void."
strings.tagGDX1MedalB105_Desc: "The bloodshot eye still moves when blood is nearby."
strings.tagGDX1MedalB106_Desc: "The bloodshot eye bewilders any lesser creature that gazes upon it."
strings.tagGDX1MedalB111_Desc: "The still twitching eye is teeming with unlife."
strings.tagGDX1MedalC103_Desc: "A reminder of those lost and forgotten."
strings.tagGDX1MedalC104_Desc: "This medal once belonged to an inquisitor whose name was stricken from the record, his reputation tarnished for a vile betrayal of all that the Luminari represent."
strings.tagGDX1MedalC105_Desc: "Mark of the Vaultkeepers, sacred guardians of the Vault of the Luminari."
strings.tagGDX1MedalD104_Desc: "Commendation bestowed upon members of the Gildam Arcanum who look past the tensions between the Luminari and the Arcanists and choose to see the bigger picture: ensuring the survival of mankind."
strings.tagGDX1MedalD105_Desc: "Commendation once given to High Inquisitor Serenir, who valiantly wielded the Horn of Gandarr to vanquish an occult coven singlehandedly."
strings.tagGDX1MedalD113_Desc: "Used by the faithful of Ulzuin to sear their flesh and dedicate themselves to the wrathful god."
strings.tagGDX1NecklaceC103_Desc: "At rare moments, the heart still beats."
strings.tagGDX1NecklaceC104_Desc: "Despite the turmoil and suffering upon Cairn, the stone fills you with undue tranquility."
strings.tagGDX1NecklaceC106_Desc: "Warding amulet of Inquisitor Gillad, thought lost after his body was never recovered following a failed excursion into a fringe village on the empire's borders accused of harboring occultists."
strings.tagGDX1NecklaceD101_Desc: "The soul of every slain enemy is quickly captured within this necklace."
strings.tagGDX1NecklaceD103_Desc: "The phial is filled with blood from the wendigo Ravager itself."
strings.tagGDX1NecklaceD113_Desc: "Peering into the eye reveals images of a vast and strange land, teeming with creatures and fiends unlike any native to Cairn."
strings.tagGDX1NecklaceD114_Desc: "The flame given off by this crystal never fully goes out."
strings.tagGDX1RelicB102Desc: "A tormented soul stirs within this stone."
strings.tagGDX1RelicC101Desc: "The unrelenting feeling that all things must end."
strings.tagGDX1RelicD101Desc: "Raw arcane energy, tainted by vile desires."
strings.tagGDX1RelicD103Desc: "A terrifying song emanates from this stone."
strings.tagGDX1RelicD105Desc: "Become the hand of fate and seal the destinies of your foes."
strings.tagGDX1RelicD106Desc: "To serve me is to serve Cairn.  -Empyrion"
strings.tagGDX1RelicD107Desc: "A binding with the Three cannot be undone."
strings.tagGDX1RelicD108Desc: "Treacherous venom, or tool of the trade."
strings.tagGDX1RelicD109Desc: "Entirety of existence, in the blink of an eye."
strings.tagGDX1RelicD111Desc: "Passed down by the master of undeath himself."
strings.tagGDX1RelicD112Desc: "The Stone of Ignaffar was not the only artifact recovered by the Luminari from an ancient burial and later purified."
strings.tagGDX1RelicD113Desc: "The lonely wolf dies, the pack survives."
strings.tagGDX1RelicD114Desc: "A vicious spirit yearns to be free"
strings.tagGDX1RingB101_Desc: "The thorns along the band draw blood, but that seems to revitalize the vines."
strings.tagGDX1RingB103_Desc: "The burning band is painful to the touch, but yet does not inflict physical harm."
strings.tagGDX1RingC101_Desc: "This twisted ring is rumored to have borne a terrifying curse for its master, the effects of which still linger within it to this day."
strings.tagGDX1RingC104_Desc: "Mark of the Runefather, creator of the original runic tongue now commonly used by the Luminari."
strings.tagGDX1RingC105_Desc: "Secrets of the stars whisper from this ring, but they are incomprehensible to untrained ears."
strings.tagGDX1RingD102_Desc: "The glyph upon this ring is said to be the most powerful spiritbinding symbol known to the Order of Death's Vigil."
strings.tagGDX1RingD103_Desc: "Whispers emanate from this ring that threaten your very sanity."
strings.tagGDX1ShieldB101Desc: "The shield's proportions require equally colossal strength."
strings.tagGDX1ShieldC102_Desc: "This shield's history is almost as long as the Black Legion's own."
strings.tagGDX1ShieldD101_Desc: "Forever damned are those that partake of the Wendigo's gift."
strings.tagGDX1ShieldD102_Desc: "The stone face is said to only open its eyes when the empire is in dire need."
strings.tagGDX1ShieldD107_Desc: "Bulwark of the faceless defender of Menhir, who stood alone against a gathering of heretics and emerged the victor."
strings.tagGDX1ShieldD110_Desc: "The shield channels through it devastating power."
strings.tagGDX1ShoulderB103_Desc: "The tough skin of an Ugdenbog kraken may be difficult to work with, but it is prized among craftsmen for good reason."
strings.tagGDX1ShoulderC103_Desc: "Not even the fury of a hundred storms was enough to shatter this armor."
strings.tagGDX1ShoulderD103_Desc: "The scrolls are lined with spells and techniques written down by generations of Cortosian Arcanists."
strings.tagGDX1ShoulderD110_Desc: "The armor fills the wearer with a fiery rage that never subsides."
strings.tagGDX1TorsoB103_Desc: "The robes shimmer with finely woven arcane runes."
strings.tagGDX1TorsoC103_Desc: "Often worn by spirit guides, the robes were a sign of gifted diviners, though given the fickle nature of fate's strands, they could just as easily be mistaken for charlatans."
strings.tagGDX1TorsoC104_Desc: "Evidently crafted for an Erulan nobleman, the cloth feels very soft, and yet resilient."
strings.tagGDX1TorsoD103_Desc: "Though the original bearer of this armor perished in a devastating blaze invoked by a rogue arcanist, the armor miraculously emerged from the inferno unscathed."
strings.tagGDX1TorsoD109_Desc: "Fickle and always changing, the strands of fate weave mankind's destiny into the unknown."
strings.tagGDX1WaistC102_Desc: "Bound spirits were woven into the threads of this belt."
strings.tagGDX1WaistC116_Desc: "Each plate drenched in the blood spilled upon the battlefield."
strings.tagGDX1WaistD103_Desc: "Wandering spirits are drawn to the weave of this belt."
strings.tagGDX1WaistD104_Desc: "A collection of powders and toxins ideal for the chemical reactions that made gunpowder weaponry a worthy challenge to the arcane arts."
strings.tagGDX1WaistD106_Desc: "The scales from the great beast Beronath have not faded after centuries, and likely never will."
strings.tagGDX1WeaponAxeD101_Desc: "Formed from the claw of a past manifestation of the great Ravager."
strings.tagGDX1WeaponAxeD104_Desc: "It is uncertain whether this weapon ultimately drives the victims mad...or the bearer."
strings.tagGDX1WeaponBluntB101Desc: "The stone heart of Bargoll emanates a deadly chill."
strings.tagGDX1WeaponBluntB102Desc: "The once living core of Bargoll thirsts for life essence so that the creature can be reborn once more."
strings.tagGDX1WeaponBluntD101_Desc: "Arcanist Malakor, a close ally of the Luminari, forged this weapon in elemental flames to combat Eldritch beings on their own terms."
strings.tagGDX1WeaponCaster1hB108_Desc: "A fragment of its master's power still beats within."
strings.tagGDX1WeaponCaster1hC102_Desc: "Master Jaravuuk's ritual blade is said to cleave through the veil itself."
strings.tagGDX1WeaponCaster1hC103_Desc: "A celestial's breath, trapped eternally within the scepter."
strings.tagGDX1WeaponCaster1hC105_Desc: "The fallen Gar'Dalvur had only one thing to say to his executioners."
strings.tagGDX1WeaponCaster1hC116_Desc: "Visions of the fallen city of Port Valbury flood your mind."
strings.tagGDX1WeaponCaster1hD102_Desc: "The blade slips between realities with strange ease, as if a key fitting into its lock."
strings.tagGDX1WeaponCaster1hD105_Desc: "A weapon inspired by the original Storm Box of Elgoloth, the runes of which now emblazon this scepter."
strings.tagGDX1WeaponCaster1hD106_Desc: "It hungers for spells to feed upon, but will just as readily feast upon its wielder."
strings.tagGDX1WeaponCaster1hD114_Desc: "Gazing upon this weapon is like staring into the vast emptiness of the beyond, incredible and overwhelming."
strings.tagGDX1WeaponCaster1hD118Desc: "Visions of the fallen city of Port Valbury flood your mind."
strings.tagGDX1WeaponGun1hB101Desc: "Infused with the spirit of the Wendigo."
strings.tagGDX1WeaponGun1hB102Desc: "Each bullet is dipped into a unique concoction crafted from the various beasts inhabiting Ugdenbog."
strings.tagGDX1WeaponGun1hC102_Desc: "Sidearm of Inquisitor Aldur, renowned hunter of heretics and slayer of Galbar'Thuul."
strings.tagGDX1WeaponGun1hC103_Desc: "A flicker of the once mighty guardian's flame still glows within its core."
strings.tagGDX1WeaponGun1hD101_Desc: "Master Morguul perfected the ammunition for this pistol, combining necrotic powers with deadly toxins to create an agent that greatly accelerates rot and decay."
strings.tagGDX1WeaponGun1hD102_Desc: "Sidearm specifically devised by Inquisitor Anderos to amplify his already formidable mastery over arcane runes."
strings.tagGDX1WeaponGun1hD103_Desc: "Crafted to the exact specifications of Master Agrivix, Grand Arcanist of the Silver Tower."
strings.tagGDX1WeaponGun1hD110_Desc: "The barrels are runed on the inside to propel the bullets with supernatural force."
strings.tagGDX1WeaponGun1hD112_Desc: "The cylinder is loaded with a fragment of the original Rune of Hagarrad, infusing every shot with a bonechilling cold."
strings.tagGDX1WeaponGun1hD114_Desc: "The once proud guardian of nature, forever marred by the corrupting touch of the Void."
strings.tagGDX1WeaponGun1hF101_Desc: "Though crude in design, Coven secrets imbue this weapon."
strings.tagGDX1WeaponGun1hF102_Desc: "Though crude in design, Coven secrets imbue this weapon."
strings.tagGDX1WeaponGun2hB101Desc: "The stone core of a swamp golem has proven to be surprisingly malleable when exposed to arcane energies, allowing it to be forged into armor, tools or even guns."
strings.tagGDX1WeaponGun2hC102_Desc: "Forged in the essence of tormented souls."
strings.tagGDX1WeaponGun2hC106_Desc: "An unconventional design created by the nightblade master, Amarasta."
strings.tagGDX1WeaponGun2hD102_Desc: "The intense blaze emitted by this weapon is nearly as dangerous to the user as the intended target."
strings.tagGDX1WeaponGun2hD104_Desc: "Infused with Luminari secrets, this weapon unloads an unfathomable amount of force with every shot."
strings.tagGDX1WeaponGun2hF104_Desc: "Every foe a mere delay to the desolation that follows."
strings.tagGDX1WeaponMelee2hC101_Desc: "The blade of this scythe is said to cleave more than just flesh."
strings.tagGDX1WeaponMelee2hD102_Desc: "Rumored to have once been wielded by Uroboruuk himself, this weapon's edge traps souls with the slightest touch."
strings.tagGDX1WeaponMelee2hD103_Desc: "Ceremonial blade of the Luminari order that has passed from Headmaster to Headmaster for centuries."
strings.tagGDX1WeaponMelee2hD107_Desc: "Eternally dripping wet with the innards of past victims."
strings.tagGDX1WeaponSwordC101_Desc: "Once tainted by the corrupting touch of Chthonians, this blade was restored to its former glory by the Luminari."
strings.tagGDX1WeaponSwordD102_Desc: "No betrayal was felt more deeply than the day Inquisitor Pagar revealed himself to be in league with the powers of the void at a Luminari training facility."
strings.tagGDX1WeaponSwordD106_Desc: "A letter D is etched onto the hilt in blood."
strings.tagGDX2Consumable_01_Desc: "The orb's purpose, or even origins, are a mystery. Would it be wise to use such a thing..."
strings.tagGDX2Consumable_02_Desc: "A remnant of the Shattered Realm. But what purpose does it serve..."
strings.tagGDX2Consumable_03_Desc: "This orb shimmers with void energies. It's probably not safe to handle..."
strings.tagGDX2Consumable_04_Desc: "The black liquid inside emits no scent, yet your senses are appalled by it. Its very presence seems to nullify magic."
strings.tagGDX2DifficultyUnlock01_Desc: Proof of conquering Cairn's terrors and earning Elite Difficulty status. Beware: entering higher difficulties prematurely will pose grave challenges! Can be placed in the Transfer Stash to use on other characters.
strings.tagGDX2DifficultyUnlock02_Desc: Proof of vanquishing Cairn's terrors and earning Ultimate Difficulty status. Beware: entering higher difficulties prematurely will pose grave challenges! Can be placed in the Transfer Stash to use on other characters.
strings.tagGDX2EnchantA201Desc: "Crystals infused with the scorching sun of the Korvan Plateau."(Applied to all one-handed weapons, shields and caster off-hands)
strings.tagGDX2EnchantA202Desc: "Crystals infused with the scorching sun of the Korvan Plateau."(Applied to all two-handed weapons)
strings.tagGDX2EnchantA203Desc: "Venom from the Korvan viper, carefully extracted and stored in an enchanted pouch so as not to dissolve the container."(Applied to all one-handed weapons, shields and caster off-hands)
strings.tagGDX2EnchantA204Desc: "Venom from the Korvan viper, carefully extracted and stored in an enchanted pouch so as not to dissolve the container."(Applied to all two-handed weapons)
strings.tagGDX2EnchantA205Desc: "A fang finely ground into enchanting powder, gathered from the sandclaws roaming the Korvan dunes."(Applied to all one-handed weapons, shields and caster off-hands)
strings.tagGDX2EnchantA206Desc: "A fang finely ground into enchanting powder, gathered from the sandclaws roaming the Korvan dunes."(Applied to all two-handed weapons)
strings.tagGDX2EnchantA207Desc: "When sandclaw matriarchs molt, some of their scales have absorbed more of the ambient eldritch energies in the region than others. Those make for the most potent enchantments."(Applied to rings and amulets)
strings.tagGDX2EnchantA208Desc: "Scales collected from the Korvan vipers, almost as challenging to gather as their venomous fangs."(Applied to rings and amulets)
strings.tagGDX2EnchantA209Desc: "Cinders from the trees incinerated by a forgotten god's wrath."(Applied to rings and amulets)
strings.tagGDX2EnchantA210Desc: "The stench coming from the powder is merely a sampling of the grotesque scents emitted by the actual plant."(Applied to rings and amulets)
strings.tagGDX2EnchantA211Desc: "Korvan cacti greedily retain precious water in the Korvan Plateau, and absorb the eldritch energies that teem within."(Applied to all one-handed weapons, shields and caster off-hands)
strings.tagGDX2EnchantA212Desc: "Korvan cacti greedily retain precious water in the Korvan Plateau, and absorb the eldritch energies that teem within."(Applied to all two-handed weapons)
strings.tagGDX2EnchantA213Desc: "Powder derived from a rare plant found only within the Korvan Plateau, its biology seems to be unlike any other fauna in the region."(Applied to all one-handed weapons, shields and caster off-hands)
strings.tagGDX2EnchantA214Desc: "Powder derived from a rare plant found only within the Korvan Plateau, its biology seems to be unlike any other fauna in the region."(Applied to all two-handed weapons)
strings.tagGDX2EnchantA215Desc: "The shells of the Korvan scarabs make for fine enchanting powder, if you can actually manage to crush them."(Applied to all one-handed weapons, shields and caster off-hands)
strings.tagGDX2EnchantA216Desc: "The shells of the Korvan scarabs make for fine enchanting powder, if you can actually manage to crush them."(Applied to all two-handed weapons)
strings.tagGDX2EnchantA217Desc: "Fang from a mythical eldritch creature rarely seen outside of the Eldritch Realm."(Applied to rings and amulets)
strings.tagGDX2EnchantA218Desc: "The sagethorn is considered invaluable among scholars for its dark red ink, but those harvesting it must take care around the thorny exterior lest they suffer lesions that never truly heal."(Applied to rings and amulets)
strings.tagGDX2EnchantA219Desc: "Powder derived from disturbing manifestations of the void that seemingly feed on the barrier between realities."(Applied to rings and amulets)
strings.tagGDX2EnchantA220Desc: "Enchanting powder derived from the ashes within the Void itself. You sense a hint of human souls within the mix, but can't be sure if that's an addition, or another unpleasant aspect of the void."(Applied to rings and amulets)
strings.tagGDX2EnchantA221Desc: "Teeming with eldritch energies and nearly impossible to turn to powder without arcane tools."(Applied to all one-handed weapons, shields and caster off-hands)
strings.tagGDX2EnchantA222Desc: "Teeming with eldritch energies and nearly impossible to turn to powder without arcane tools."(Applied to all two-handed weapons)
strings.tagGDX2EnchantA223Desc: "The powdered petals of a potent plant found growing near now seldom seen pools of water within the Korvan Plateau."(Applied to all one-handed weapons, shields and caster off-hands)
strings.tagGDX2EnchantA224Desc: "The powdered petals of a potent plant found growing near now seldom seen pools of water within the Korvan Plateau."(Applied to all two-handed weapons)
strings.tagGDX2EnchantA225Desc: "Powder derived from the talons of gryphons inhabiting the Korvan Plateau."(Applied to all one-handed weapons, shields and caster off-hands)
strings.tagGDX2EnchantA226Desc: "Powder derived from the talons of gryphons inhabiting the Korvan Plateau."(Applied to all two-handed weapons)
strings.tagGDX2EnchantA227Desc: "Powder derived from a vibrant red plant found growing within the Korvan Plateau."(Applied to rings and amulets)
strings.tagGDX2EnchantA228Desc: "Venom from the tail glands of the deadly creatures roaming the desert sands."(Applied to rings and amulets)
strings.tagGDX2EnchantA229Desc: "Arcane essence from the various guardians roaming the temples of the Korvan Plateau."(Applied to rings and amulets)
strings.tagGDX2EnchantA230Desc: "The essence of a wraithlike spirit bound into bonemeal for enchanting purposes."(Applied to rings and amulets)
strings.tagGDX2EnchantB201Desc: "A gift from the witch god Bysmiel, perfectly attuned to the minds of minions."(Applied to all one-handed weapons, shields and caster off-hands)
strings.tagGDX2EnchantB202Desc: "A gift from the witch god Bysmiel, perfectly attuned to the minds of minions."(Applied to all two-handed weapons)
strings.tagGDX2EnchantB203Desc: "A gift from the witch god Bysmiel to give her servants an edge in physical combat, when retreating into the shadows is not an option."(Applied to all one-handed weapons, shields and caster off-hands)
strings.tagGDX2EnchantB204Desc: "A gift from the witch god Bysmiel to give her servants an edge in physical combat, when retreating into the shadows is not an option."(Applied to all two-handed weapons)
strings.tagGDX2EnchantB205Desc: "A gift from the witch god Bysmiel, attuned to the veil that divides the living from the dead."(Applied to all one-handed weapons, shields and caster off-hands)
strings.tagGDX2EnchantB206Desc: "A gift from the witch god Bysmiel, attuned to the veil that divides the living from the dead."(Applied to all two-handed weapons)
strings.tagGDX2EnchantB207Desc: "A potent enchanting powder derived from the relics found within the Temple of Ateph, intended to bolster the bond between master and minion."(Applied to rings and amulets)
strings.tagGDX2EnchantB208Desc: "A potent enchanting powder derived from the relics found within the Temple of Ateph which infuses equipment with a chilling touch."(Applied to rings and amulets)
strings.tagGDX2EnchantB209Desc: "A potent enchanting powder derived from the relics found within the Temple of Ateph that grants the wielder a taste for blood."(Applied to rings and amulets)
strings.tagGDX2EnchantB210Desc: "A potent enchanting powder derived from the relics found within the Temple of Ateph that shields the wielder from harm."(Applied to rings and amulets)
strings.tagGDX2EnchantB211Desc: "A gift from the witch god Dreeg that bestows upon the bearer a mere taste of the Great Guardian's vision for Cairn."(Applied to all one-handed weapons, shields and caster off-hands)
strings.tagGDX2EnchantB212Desc: "A gift from the witch god Dreeg that bestows upon the bearer a mere taste of the Great Guardian's vision for Cairn."(Applied to all two-handed weapons)
strings.tagGDX2EnchantB213Desc: "A gift from the witch god Dreeg derived from one of the Great Guardian's spines, ever dripping with acid."(Applied to all one-handed weapons, shields and caster off-hands)
strings.tagGDX2EnchantB214Desc: "A gift from the witch god Dreeg derived from one of the Great Guardian's spines, ever dripping with acid."(Applied to all two-handed weapons)
strings.tagGDX2EnchantB215Desc: "A gift, or perhaps a curse, from the witch god Dreeg that grants the bearer a fragment of a possible future where the void reigns supreme over all creation."(Applied to all one-handed weapons, shields and caster off-hands)
strings.tagGDX2EnchantB216Desc: "A gift, or perhaps a curse, from the witch god Dreeg that grants the bearer a fragment of a possible future where the void reigns supreme over all creation."(Applied to all two-handed weapons)
strings.tagGDX2EnchantB217Desc: "A dense enchanting powder derived from the desiccated remains of Osyr's priesthood, tainted by a darkness without name."(Applied to rings and amulets)
strings.tagGDX2EnchantB218Desc: "A dense enchanting powder derived from the desiccated remains of Osyr's priesthood, still blessed by the lost god's word."(Applied to rings and amulets)
strings.tagGDX2EnchantB219Desc: "A dense enchanting powder derived from the desiccated remains of Osyr's priesthood, attuned to the mastery of conjured creatures."(Applied to rings and amulets)
strings.tagGDX2EnchantB220Desc: "A dense enchanting powder derived from the desiccated remains of Osyr's priesthood, still teeming with raw arcane energies."(Applied to rings and amulets)
strings.tagGDX2EnchantB221Desc: "A gift from the witch god Solael, promising untold destruction upon his enemies."(Applied to all one-handed weapons, shields and caster off-hands)
strings.tagGDX2EnchantB222Desc: "A gift from the witch god Solael, promising untold destruction upon his enemies."(Applied to all two-handed weapons)
strings.tagGDX2EnchantB223Desc: "A gift from the witch god Solael, granting the bearer a taste of the Eldritch Flame's endless hunger."(Applied to all one-handed weapons, shields and caster off-hands)
strings.tagGDX2EnchantB224Desc: "A gift from the witch god Solael, granting the bearer a taste of the Eldritch Flame's endless hunger."(Applied to all two-handed weapons)
strings.tagGDX2EnchantB225Desc: "A gift from the witch god Solael, infused with the essence of the Eldritch Flame's will."(Applied to all one-handed weapons, shields and caster off-hands)
strings.tagGDX2EnchantB226Desc: "A gift from the witch god Solael, infused with the essence of the Eldritch Flame's will."(Applied to all two-handed weapons)
strings.tagGDX2EnchantB227Desc: "A fine enchanting powder derived from the ashes of the pyres within Irrah's temple, still infused with soul fragments of sacrificial victims."(Applied to rings and amulets)
strings.tagGDX2EnchantB228Desc: "A fine enchanting powder derived from the ashes of the pyres within Irrah's temple that fills the bearer with an unnatural calm."(Applied to rings and amulets)
strings.tagGDX2EnchantB229Desc: "A fine enchanting powder derived from the ashes of the pyres within Irrah's temple, infused with various toxins found among the flora and fauna of the Korvan Plateau."(Applied to rings and amulets)

strings.tagNecklaceC010Desc: "A charm once worn to ward off evil spirits."
strings.tagNecklaceC011Desc: "Trapped residual essence of the great beast Beronath."
strings.tagNecklaceC014Desc: "A perfect emerald openly flaunted by Master of Taxes Androneus Phillian, prior to his introduction to a knife in the back."
strings.tagNecklaceC016: Unseeing Eye of the Blind Assassin
strings.tagNecklaceC019Desc: "A mere glance at this gem creates an intense desire to take it as your own."
strings.tagNecklaceD003Desc: "First of the seven sacred virtues of humanity."
strings.tagNecklaceD005Desc: "The embalmed eye of the great beast, Beronath."
strings.tagNecklaceD007Desc: "A physical manifestation of the suffering and death witnessed at the beginning of the Grim Dawn."
strings.tagNecklaceD009Desc: "Focusing gem of Arcanist Geneve Halakor, who forsook her order and its teachings to join the Luminari."
strings.tagNecklaceD011Desc: "Rumored to have torn open the first rift at the beginning of the Grim Dawn."
strings.tagNecklaceD012Desc: "Bearer of the seven plagues of the witch god Dreeg."
strings.tagPotionConstitutionA01Desc: "Tastes like stale dirt but lasts forever and restores lost constitution."
strings.tagPotionConstitutionB01Desc: Lingering vital energy that can be absorbed to restore lost constitution.
strings.tagRelicB003Desc: "Balance in an elemental sea of unrest."
strings.tagRelicB004Desc: "A core of ice and a heart of stone."
strings.tagRelicB005Desc: "The tumultuous spirit of Ultos, Arkovian god of the sky."
strings.tagRelicB009Desc: "Subtlety and wit over brute force and muscle."
strings.tagRelicB010Desc: "Unmatched passion to wage war in the name of Oleron."
strings.tagRelicB011Desc: "A talisman carried by trolls to drive them into a mindless battlerage that does not end until every enemy lies dead."
strings.tagRelicB012Desc: "A symbol of expertise in the art of wielding two melee weapons at the same time."
strings.tagRelicB013Desc: "A symbol of expertise in the art of firing two pistols at the same time with lethal accuracy."
strings.tagRelicB014Desc: "This chip of bone was meticulously covered with phrases and symbols of spiritual importance to the Rovers."
strings.tagRelicC002Desc: "The immovable defender and bastion of the weak."
strings.tagRelicC003Desc: "Not all nightblade assignments end with a clean kill."
strings.tagRelicC004Desc: "A force of destruction that will not be denied."
strings.tagRelicC005Desc: "Visions of terror and horrors from the dark places of the world."
strings.tagRelicC006Desc: "A memento of the Arkovian Steps of Torment, filled with the agony of its innumerable victims."
strings.tagRelicC007Desc: "Ageless spirits, eager to escape into the world of the living."
strings.tagRelicC010Desc: "The chilling touch of death lingers hungrily over all..."
strings.tagRelicC011Desc: "Spill blood so that those who cannot will never have to."
strings.tagRelicC013Desc: "Leave nothing but desolation in your wake."
strings.tagRelicC014Desc: "The master stroke of the nine plagues of Dreeg."
strings.tagRelicC015Desc: "Within our ancestry lies the key to true potential."
strings.tagRelicC016Desc: "A symbol of supremacy in the art of wielding two melee weapons at the same time."
strings.tagRelicC017Desc: "A symbol of supremacy in the art of firing two pistols at the same time with lethal accuracy."
strings.tagRelicD001Desc: "The guiding light of Ishtak cleanses of pain and fills with renewed resolve."
strings.tagRelicD002Desc: "Plague and disease are an unmatched force, felling both the cripple and the warrior alike."
strings.tagRelicD003Desc: "The moon as my guide, shadows my allies. I am the hunter..."
strings.tagRelicD004Desc: "Become like the unbreachable citadel and behold as your enemies meet their doom before your insurmountable walls."
strings.tagRelicD005Desc: "Those who seek divine power need but to look up to the skies during a lightning storm."
strings.tagRelicD007Desc: "I fear not the reaper, for I am death incarnate."
strings.tagRelicD009Desc: "In the end of all things, we all share the same fate."
strings.tagRelicD010Desc: "The secrets of the aether are ours for the taking. I simply do not fear what lies beyond the veil."
strings.tagRelicD011Desc: "I have looked into the great dark beyond expecting the empty void. I never expected it to look back."
strings.tagRelicD012Desc: "My brother nightblades have their methods, and I have mine. There are no innocents."
strings.tagRelicD013Desc: "The skies shall tear asunder, and fire shall rain from crimson heavens..."
strings.tagRelicD014Desc: "It is true, you have landed a mighty blow; but the last one shall be mine."
strings.tagRelicD015Desc: "Come forth, my minions. It is time to feast..."
strings.tagRelicD016Desc: "They said no man could harness such power, so I ceased to be a man."
strings.tagRelicD017Desc: "The greatest secret kept from you is the fallacy of your fragile mortality."
strings.tagRelicD018Desc: "Look at them, little puppets, all moving along my invisible strings."
strings.tagRelicD019Desc: "Blood... agony... death. Will you deny the drums of war?"
strings.tagRelicD020Desc: "The earth will suffer neither foul spirit nor vile blood of heathens. Rise up to her defense and Cairn will rise with you."
strings.tagRelicD021Desc: "The first lesson every aspirant must learn is to find a balance in the raw forces of magic that surround us all."
strings.tagRelicD022Desc: "A symbol of mastery in the art of wielding two melee weapons at the same time."
strings.tagRelicD023Desc: "A symbol of mastery in the art of firing two pistols at the same time with lethal accuracy."
strings.tagRingB001Desc: "A worn out inscription along the band says: With love - Amelia"
strings.tagRingB002Desc: "Stained with the blood of his victims, now joined by his own."
strings.tagRingB003Desc: "Likely the most valuable item the family had ever owned."
strings.tagRingB005Desc: "The gem within shimmers during summoning rituals."
strings.tagRingB006Desc: "A crudely fashioned piece of jewelry. Strange that a slith would use such a thing."
strings.tagRingC006Desc: "Cast from the burning remains of a fallen star."
strings.tagRingC008Desc: "A ring commonly carried by nobles possessed by Aetherial spirits."
strings.tagRingC023Desc: "The sapphires within this ring absorb heat with the slightest touch."
strings.tagRingC033Desc: "The gem keeps shifting and changing shape before your eyes."
strings.tagRingD002Desc: "Signet granted by Kelphat'Zoth, Grand Harbinger of Ch'Thon, upon his most loyal followers."
strings.tagRingD005Desc: "A mockery of the agonizing possession process."
strings.tagRingD007Desc: "Signet of the Black Matriach, a ruthless assassin who utilized spider venom to paralyze and execute her opponents."
strings.tagRingD010Desc: "Master Albrecht, creator of the aether ray, was renowned not only for his mastery of the arcane, but also his connection to the eldritch gods; a fact that garnered him much legal trouble and would have ended in his execution if not for the intervention of the Gildam Arcanum."
strings.tagShieldB001Desc: "Forged from hardened steel and ruthless hatred."
strings.tagShieldC002Desc: "Forged by necromantic ritual as a bulwark against vile spirits."
strings.tagShieldC007Desc: "Carried by the Black Legion of the Imperial army, also known as the Death's Bannermen."
strings.tagShieldC009Desc: "Forged from the purest shard of soladrin crystal."
strings.tagShieldC013Desc: "Forged by arcane smiths to channel the raw forces of the elements."
strings.tagShieldC014Desc: "Overlapping layers of chitin from the slain Dermapteran Queen."
strings.tagShieldD001Desc: "Necromantic shield molded from the chest cavity of an unfortunate peasant."
strings.tagShieldD002Desc: "Forged by railyard workers during a desperate battle against the rising Chthonian forces."
strings.tagShieldD004Desc: "Formerly the Emperor's Crest, this shield has passed through Aetherfire to become a paragon of mankind."
strings.tagShoulderC001Desc: "Stitched together from the carcass of Razorback."
strings.tagShoulderC005Desc: "Seared and shredded by shrapnel, this shoulderguard nevertheless retains much of its protective qualities."
strings.tagShoulderC006Desc: "Symbolic garment of a secretive order eradicated during the reign of the Arcanist King, Samuel Drake."
strings.tagShoulderC009Desc: "A mantle of great raven feathers, bestowed by the witch god Bysmiel upon her mortal followers."
strings.tagShoulderD001Desc: "The strands of fate, like an endless weave, intertwine and fray with the passing ages of man."
strings.tagShoulderD002Desc: "Pauldrons bestowed upon masters of the Templar order who have gone beyond their mortal duties to become Exemplars."
strings.tagShoulderD005Desc: "The markings on these pauldrons are as if from another era."
strings.tagShoulderD020Desc: "The mantle worn by the avatar of Mogdrogen himself."
strings.tagSurvivalDifficultyUnlock01_Desc: Proof of conquering the Crucible and achieving the status of Challenger. Can be placed in the Transfer Stash to use on other characters.
strings.tagSurvivalDifficultyUnlock02_Desc: Proof of conquering the Crucible and achieving the status of Gladiator. Can be placed in the Transfer Stash to use on other characters.
strings.tagTorsoC011Desc: "It is unknown as to how many victims it took to sew together these foul robes."
strings.tagTorsoC014Desc: "Priest's robes once worn by members of the Weeping Eye cabal."
strings.tagTorsoC016Desc: "Chthonian robes worn only by elite members of the bloodthirsty cult."
strings.tagTorsoC019: Stealth Jacket of the Blind Assassin
strings.tagTorsoC022Desc: "Armor commissioned by the famed battle master, Zolhan."
strings.tagTorsoD003Desc: "The strange cloth shimmers and fades with the light, creating a mesmerizing illusion around the wearer."
strings.tagTorsoD004Desc: "Robes of the high priest of Dreeg, charged with safeguarding the witch god's earthly concerns."
strings.tagTorsoD005Desc: "Azragor was a brutal man feared amongst his fellow knights for his underhanded, yet undisputable tactics."
strings.tagTorsoD006Desc: "Korvoran was a legendary nightblade renowned for his deadly accuracy with throwing knives, which he was able to procure even when his belt was seemingly devoid of blades."
strings.tagTorsoD008Desc: "Armor bestowed upon masters of the Templar order who have gone beyond their mortal duties to become Exemplars."
strings.tagWaistC002Desc: "Worked wonders for Frizzick until it ran out of zombie repellent."
strings.tagWaistC011Desc: "The chains grant unspeakable power, but at equal cost in blood."
strings.tagWaistD001: Thorn Girdle of the Misty Glade
strings.tagWaistD005Desc: "Once worn by an eccentric mass murderer convinced that wearing the entrails of his victims would in turn protect his own."
strings.tagWaistD006Desc: "Every tool known to man, somehow contained within a single belt."
strings.tagWaistD013Desc: "Waistguard worn by the Spellbreaker regiment, a selective group within the Templar of Menhir."
strings.tagWaistD014Desc: "Woven using thread spun from the souls of the damned through unspeakable necromantic techniques."
strings.tagWeaponAxeC002Desc: "An ancient implement of ritual sacrifice, forged by a long-dead people."
strings.tagWeaponAxeC006Desc: "A cruel weapon owned by a cruel man."
strings.tagWeaponAxeC010Desc: "The edge of this weapon harnesses the Aether itself."
strings.tagWeaponAxeC011: Notched Bone of a Thousand Deaths
strings.tagWeaponAxeC013Desc: "A shamanistic axe comprising of various unidentifiable human and animal bones."
strings.tagWeaponAxeD001Desc: "Embodiment of the madness and depravity that overwhelmed the people of Cairn following the Grim Dawn."
strings.tagWeaponAxeD002Desc: "Blessed weapon of moon worshippers, thought destroyed during the Sacred Purge."
strings.tagWeaponAxeD004Desc: "Legends speak of a mortal who, when beseeched by the gods, cleaved Mount Menhir in two, forming Menhir's Twins."
strings.tagWeaponBluntB001Desc: "It is unclear how many innocent men lost their lives at the mercy of this weapon."
strings.tagWeaponBluntC002Desc: "This once holy scepter has been twisted into its current form after being anointed with the living blood of Ch'thon."
strings.tagWeaponBluntC003Desc: "A despicable weapon that has claimed countless human lives."
strings.tagWeaponBluntC007Desc: "The burning hammer of the Guardians of Menhir."
strings.tagWeaponBluntC009Desc: "The embodiment of the adaptability of mankind."
strings.tagWeaponBluntC016Desc: "Sacred gavel of Archon Barthollem, used to pass divine judgment upon the unworthy."
strings.tagWeaponCaster1hC004_Desc: "The blade sparks with energy, always hungry for more power."
strings.tagWeaponCaster1hC007_Desc: "It is said that this blade cuts deeper than just the flesh."
strings.tagWeaponCaster1hC008_Desc: "Implement favored by the Cortosian Masters during arcane invocations."
strings.tagWeaponCaster1hC013_Desc: "Forged from the heart of a fallen star."
strings.tagWeaponCaster1hC014_Desc: "Nera'Val was a medical practitioner obsessed with curing a deadly wasting disease. He infected and killed dozens of innocents in his mad pursuit and was hanged for his crimes."
strings.tagWeaponCaster1hC016_Desc: "Weaves the aether through reality as a needle threads cloth."
strings.tagWeaponCaster1hC023_Desc: "Strange whispers in a language you cannot comprehend emanate from the scepter."
strings.tagWeaponCaster1hD001Desc: "Ancient folklore spoke of a cloaked figure that traveled the world cleansing disease and mending wounds, never once asking for payment or any other sign of gratitude."
strings.tagWeaponCaster1hD006Desc: "The implement once belonging to Master Panetti, master of spell replication and creator of the Replicating Missile."
strings.tagWeaponCaster1hD008Desc: "The blade steals heat from the air, like a chilling mountain wind."
strings.tagWeaponCaster1hD011Desc: "Time itself warps around this dagger's edge."
strings.tagWeaponCaster1hD019Desc: "With his final decree, Van Aldritch condemned an entire city to the Grim Dawn."
strings.tagWeaponCrossbow2hC001Desc: "A prototype weapon. Unfortunately, its inventor was slain before it could be taken to mass production."
strings.tagWeaponCrossbow2hC003Desc: "An ill-fated weapon with too many past owners to speak of."
strings.tagWeaponCrossbow2hC004Desc: "Crafted using wood from the forest outside Blackwood Manor."
strings.tagWeaponCrossbow2hC008Desc: "Symbolic weapon of devout followers of Bysmiel."
strings.tagWeaponCrossbow2hC009Desc: "A crude, yet surprisingly effective, weapon of the mountain wilds."
strings.tagWeaponCrossbow2hC011Desc: "Preferred weapon of Altos Nar, the arcanist-turned assassin."
strings.tagWeaponCrossbow2hD001Desc: "The weapon of choice for Demon Hunter Edith the Bloodied, Chthonian cultist turned demonslayer."
strings.tagWeaponCrossbow2hD002Desc: "Infused with the very essence of the witch god Dreeg."
strings.tagWeaponCrossbow2hD003Desc: "The great wyrm freezes all that it touches before devouring it whole."
strings.tagWeaponGun1hC001Desc: "Taken from the cold dead hands of the Blackwater bandit."
strings.tagWeaponGun1hC002Desc: "Infused with dark magic to battle foul abusers of the arcane on their own terms."
strings.tagWeaponGun1hC003Desc: "The old priest wasn't known for his peace talks."
strings.tagWeaponGun1hC007Desc: "Inscribed on the barrel is a single word: Loyal."
strings.tagWeaponGun1hC014: Frigid Barrel of the Relentless North
strings.tagWeaponGun1hD003Desc: "Sidearm of Inquisitor Josian Farral, used during her purge of the heretical witch god worshippers."
strings.tagWeaponGun1hD005Desc: "Crafted to the exact specifications of Master Agrivix, Grand Arcanist of the Silver Tower."
strings.tagWeaponGun2hC005Desc: "Every bullet is destined to meet its true mark, regardless of who stands in its way."
strings.tagWeaponGun2hC007Desc: "A scrapped-together weapon designed to destroy Aetherials."
strings.tagWeaponGun2hD002Desc: "Weapon blessed by the witch gods and gifted to their followers in order to defend their sanctuaries from the wrath of the inquisition."
strings.tagWeaponGun2hD003Desc: "The barrel spews forth the fury of the seven hells."
strings.tagWeaponGun2hD004Desc: "Every shot fired sends ripples through the aether."
strings.tagWeaponMelee2hC003Desc: "Earned its name for the countless abomination skulls it split in two."
strings.tagWeaponMelee2hC006Desc: "A rare success in the experimentation of arcane forging techniques."
strings.tagWeaponMelee2hC010Desc: "A historic weapon from the rebellion of Farmstead, mercilessly crushed by Imperial forces."
strings.tagWeaponMelee2hC013Desc: "Forged using ancient techniques now lost to the ages."
strings.tagWeaponMelee2hC014Desc: "The Lifestealer of Tenebris, the Blood Drinker."
strings.tagWeaponMelee2hC015Desc: "Great hammer of Brother Bernard Mellington of the Templar."
strings.tagWeaponMelee2hD003Desc: "Unorthodox tool of Master of Assassins Belanor. Few Nightblades had ever mastered the art of the greatsword as he had."
strings.tagWeaponMelee2hD004Desc: "Forged within the molten depths of a living volcano."
strings.tagWeaponMelee2hD005Desc: "Birthed when the blessed spear of Paladin Allister Forgebearer met with the heart of a greater demon."
strings.tagWeaponMelee2hD006Desc: "Charged over countless lightning storms, this weapon is primed to unleash nature's fury."
strings.tagWeaponMelee2hD007Desc: "Sacred blade of King Hrothnar, ruler of the northern reaches and son of the great white wolf."
strings.tagWeaponMelee2hD012_Desc: "The right hand of Alkamos, the devourer of souls and tormentor of the wicked."
strings.tagWeaponMelee2hD013_Desc: "The weapon has spilled oceans of blood for Ch'thon, and it yearns for more."
strings.tagWeaponSwordB001Desc: "Granted to the Blade of Ch'thon for his unwavering service."
strings.tagWeaponSwordB013Desc: "The blade of Thalonis, sanctified in the blood of Ch'thon."
strings.tagWeaponSwordC002Desc: "The blade's edge reeks of rot and corruption."
strings.tagWeaponSwordC004Desc: "The twisted edge of madness drives all it touches insane."
strings.tagWeaponSwordC007Desc: "Delicately balanced by generations of master swordsmen."
strings.tagWeaponSwordC008Desc: "When bribing political adversaries proved insufficient, the Magistrate of Malmouth employed alternate means of negotiation."
strings.tagWeaponSwordC013Desc: "A small vial of poison is embedded in the blade, inducing stiffening paralysis and eventual death."
strings.tagWeaponSwordD001Desc: "The weapon fills its bearer with an unquenchable thirst for blood."
strings.tagWeaponSwordD002Desc: "A Soladrin crystal blade teeming with untapped power."
strings.tagWeaponSwordD005Desc: "The slayer of Beronath once broken, reforged at last as a mighty blade."
strings.tagWeaponSwordD007Desc: "You can sense your own mortality when looking upon this blade."
strings.tagWeaponSwordD008Desc: "The mere sight of this blade fills you with hope."
strings.tagWeaponSwordD010Desc: "There are letters etched into the hilt: D.T."
strings.tagWeaponSwordD012Desc: "Separated from her brood and trapped beneath the fortress walls, the dermapteran queen was slowly driven mad."
strings.tagheadC005Desc: "An initiate's helm for the Guardians of Menhir."
strings.tagheadD003Desc: "Whispers dark secrets into the ears of your victims prior to the killing blow."
strings.tagheadD004Desc: "Bound by death to a death unbound."
strings.tagheadD018Desc: "Crown of King Hrothnar, ruler of the northern reaches and son of the great white wolf."
